preconditions.expression: isinstance(grid, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The input grid is a list of lists representing a 2D matrix.

preconditions.expression: len(grid) > 0 and all(len(row) == len(grid) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The grid is a non-empty square matrix of size N x N.
The dimension N of the grid is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= cell <= 1000 for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Every cell cost is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
No negative cost cycles exist in the grid (guaranteed by the problem statement and positive costs).

postconditions.description: The function returns an integer representing the minimum cost.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(sum(grid[r][c] for r, c in path) for path in valid_paths(grid))
postconditions.description: The returned value is the minimum total cost among all valid paths from the top-left cell (0,0) to the bottom-right cell (N-1, N-1), where a valid path consists of adjacent cells (up, down, left, right) within grid bounds.
